historical_programs.sql_template: SELECT T1."XCL_001", T1."XCL_002" FROM cards AS T1 INNER JOIN legalities AS T2 ON T1."XCL_072" = T2."XCL_086" WHERE T2."XCL_085" = 'Legal' AND T2."XCL_084" = 'commander' AND (T1."XCL_055" IS NULL OR T1."XCL_055" = '*')

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T1."XCL_022" = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T1."XCL_001") FROM cards AS T1 INNER JOIN legalities AS T2 ON T1."XCL_072" = T2."XCL_086" WHERE T2."XCL_084" = 'commander' AND T2."XCL_085" = 'Legal'

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN NOT T1."XCL_006" IS NULL AND NOT T1."XCL_007" IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T1."XCL_001") FROM cards AS T1 INNER JOIN sets AS T2 ON T2."XCL_099" = T1."XCL_063" WHERE T2."XCL_110" = 'Coldsnap'
SELECT T2."XCL_089" FROM cards AS T1 INNER JOIN rulings AS T2 ON T1."XCL_072" = T2."XCL_090" WHERE (T1."XCL_055" IS NULL OR T1."XCL_055" = '*') AND T2."XCL_089" LIKE '%triggered ability%'

SELECT T1."XCL_051", T2."XCL_084" FROM cards AS T1 INNER JOIN legalities AS T2 ON T1."XCL_072" = T2."XCL_086" WHERE T1."XCL_059" = 'mythic' AND NOT T1."XCL_051" IS NULL AND T2."XCL_085" = 'Legal' ORDER BY T1."XCL_051" LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(T1."XCL_001") FROM cards AS T1 INNER JOIN legalities AS T2 ON T1."XCL_072" = T2."XCL_086" INNER JOIN rulings AS T3 ON T1."XCL_072" = T3."XCL_090" WHERE T2."XCL_084" = 'premodern' AND T3."XCL_089" = 'This is a triggered mana ability.' AND T1."XCL_064" IS NULL
